title: Register embedding + reranker artifacts and pin model variants in catalog
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Goal: Add a repeatable, auditable flow to register new embedding and pairwise reranker model artifacts into the model catalog, produce and publish machine-readable performance profiles (latency, throughput, accuracy metrics) and pin recommended model variant(s) for production routes.

Scope:
- Artifact ingestion pipeline updates: accept multi-artifact bundles (float32 base, 4-bit/8-bit quantized variants, tokenizer metadata, config).
- Profile v2 schema: include latency P50/P95, tokens/sec, memory footprint, typical sequence length distributions, embedding dimension and cosine baseline, reranker NDCG@10 and pairwise AUC, and quantization quality delta.
- Variant pinning matrix: allow teams to pin exact model+quantization+kernel combinations per route and per deployment tier (hosted/dedicated/private).
- CI validation: automated profiling across a small smoke fleet (cpu emulation + one GPU flavor) and verify compatibility with cache+batching runtime.
- Publish flow: PR to model-catalog repo triggers profile validation -> publish to Console catalog UI with rollouts and deprecation metadata.

This ticket coordinates infra changes, profile schema, CI jobs, and Console publish UX hooks. The intention is to reduce ad-hoc onboarding work and make variant recommendations deterministic for engineers and platform teams.
acceptance_criteria: Model catalog accepts artifact bundles for embeddings and pairwise rerankers (base + quantized variants + tokenizer) via the ingestion API
Profile v2 schema checked into model-catalog/specs with examples for embedding and reranker profiles
Automated profiling job runs in CI and emits a profile JSON including latency P50/P95, tokens/sec, memory use, cosine baseline for embeddings, NDCG@10 for reranker
Publish pipeline pins a default variant and exposes a matrix in Console that can be overridden per-route
Compatibility check ensures pinned variants are runnable on Dedicated and Private (basic kernel compatibility matrix) or surfaces actionable warnings
Documentation updated: onboarding checklist, QA harness instructions, and console publishing steps
